desc: Multi-instrumentalist Jay Duerr renders an expressive Latin Underscore album with featured performances on spanish and electric guitar, charango, bandoneon, strings and percussion. Emotes feelings of tension, intrigue, and passion with a Latin twist.

tracks.desc: Instrumental Latin Underscore track with an ambient, soulful SOLO CHARANGO melody followed by an uplifting bridge. Melody returns with a tremelo charango accompaniment. Brings to mind the northern Andes mountains of South America, which includes modern-day Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador, northern Chile, and northwestern Argentina.

Instrumental Latin Underscore track with a soft and gentle Spanish guitar melody against a guitar accompaniment. As percussion and bandoneon enters melody becomes more passionate with bold flurries. Strings enter along with castanets an build towards the end. Brings to mind Argentina and Uruguay.
